narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The pin can go at any corner, because the corner is a fixed point.
<bookmark mark='swing'/>Pin the corner and give a quarter turn. The cloth swings away from its outline.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The cloth no longer fits, so a corner cannot be the centre of rotation.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>The centre of rotation is the one point that stays still while the shape turns.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. A rectangle card fits itself after a half turn. Where should the pin go?
